headline: Spiked nightcaps and invitations to strangers: how Philip Young sexually abused his wife for 15 years

members.title: Four UK men convicted of sexual assault and rape of drugged woman at invitation of husband
members.lead: Four men convicted of sexual assault and rape of Joanne Young, whose husband advertised her on UK swinging websites • Spiked nightcaps and invitations to strangers: how Philip Young sexually abused his wife for 15 years A woman who was raped by strangers after being drugged by her husband has warned of “serious questions about how the law deals with consent”, as four men who abused her were convicted on Thursday. Philip Young, 50, advertised his then wife, Joanne Young, on dating and swinging websites, presenting it as a “kink” for both of them, Winchester crown court heard. In fact, he had been sedating her, plunging her into an “inanimate state” in which anything could be done to her by the men who answered the adverts, jurors were told. Continue reading...

members.title: Spiked nightcaps and invitations to strangers: how Philip Young sexually abused his wife for 15 years
members.lead: Joanne Young, who has waived anonymity, was subjected to years of drugging and rape by former Swindon councillor, who invited other men to assault her When Philip Young served as a Conservative party councillor for Swindon council, his contemporaries viewed him as a perfectly normal family man with “no edge to him”. But behind closed doors he orchestrated a systematic campaign of abuse against his then wife, Joanne Young, secretly administering sedatives to render her unconscious, disoriented and amnesiac. Over a period of at least 15 years, he and other men raped and sexually assaulted her in her own bed at their home in Swindon. Continue reading...
